title: Twindragon Fractal
description: An infinitely detailed fractal built from one simple rule, repeated forever.
long_description:
The twindragon fractal is generated by repeating one simple equation over and over. Zoom in anywhere and you'll find the same kind of structure again and again -- a property called self-similarity, and the boundary between light and dark never smooths out no matter how far you zoom.

From your phone, shift the zoom depth and colors, or jump straight to a few favorite deep-zoom spots.
